name: HPAY bonus vault setToken reward-token swap
summary: The MintableAutoCompoundRelockBonus vault let an unauthorised caller invoke setToken(), so the attacker staked a worthless self-minted token, pointed the vault back at HPAY and withdrew HPAY against the fake stake.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

ageReset.description: Legacy basis: latest of 8 pre-incident Upgraded event(s).

sources.note: onchain review: bonus proxy 0xF8bC1434f3C5a7af0BE18c00C675F7B034a002F0 created 2022-05-25T06:52:36Z by 0x346abB57CfB43aD3Bb8210E3DD1dB12353160A0b (the HPAY FeeManager), unrelated to attack sender 0xab74fbd735cd2ed826b64e0f850a890930a91094; it is a standard EIP-1967 proxy with 8 Upgraded events, the last at 1666002768 (2022-10-17T10:32:48Z), one day before the incident, so the age is measured from that upgrade rather than deployment. The attack ran across many transactions from the same EOA; the reported 115 BNB x $273.30 at incidentTimestamp 1666090831 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $31,429.
